responsibility: Implements the shared low-level binary I/O routines for GCC’s gcov ecosystem. Included into the compiler, gcov, gcov-dump, gcov-tool, and libgcov in different build modes, it owns opening/locking gcov files, endianness detection, record/tag length writing, seeking/syncing, reading and writing unsigned values, 64-bit counters, strings, summaries, and filename/path mangling for coverage outputs. This file is the executable implementation of the gcno/gcda wire format defined by gcov-io.h and is the common serialization layer used by both producers and consumers of coverage/profile data.
same_name_distinction: This source file is the executable low-level gcov serialization layer corresponding to gcc/gcov-io.h. It implements file opening/locking, endianness handling, record/tag I/O, counter/string/summary reads and writes, seeking/syncing, and path mangling, whereas the header defines the gcov file-format constants, structures, and API surface used across GCC tools.
